bounties.name: Best Mera-Powered UX on Monad
bounties.observed: Account, session and recovery flows pass in a Chromium virtual-authenticator journey and scripted local runs. The Chapter 6 testnet transactions were signed by a scripted account, not a real Mera device.
limitations: universal single-prompt onboarding is not claimed
Gate B is computed as fail (no real Mera account signed the exact action; NO_DEPLOYABLE_SIGNER), which withdraws this bounty claim until real-device evidence exists.
missing: confirmed testnet execution signed by a real Mera account (Gate B1)
storage-cleared recovery at the final rpId on a real device

bounties.name: Mera: One Passkey, Many Keys
bounties.observed: Separate account and vault PRF namespaces with browser-side encryption; recovery and decryption pass in the virtual-authenticator and scripted-storage journeys. A fresh key or cached plaintext is not counted as recovery.
limitations: a virtual authenticator is not a real device
ciphertext restore cannot recreate a deleted credential
Gate B is computed as fail (no real Mera account signed the exact action; NO_DEPLOYABLE_SIGNER), which withdraws this bounty claim until real-device evidence exists.
missing: same-credential decryption on a second real device
recovery after clearing storage at the final rpId

bounties.name: Best Use of Envio
bounties.release: not deployed (local envio dev); hosted app reports history.envio unconfigured 2026-10-13
bounties.observed: A local Envio 3.13.0 HyperIndex run ingested the real Monad Testnet registry through HyperSync from block 69534196 and projected ISSUE, SUPERSEDE and REVOKE actions for one reviewer (2 receipts: 1 superseded, 1 revoked); a controlled engine stop showed lag rising and recovery within about 45 s. Rollback tests are local and labelled so.
limitations: the indexer ran locally, not on Envio hosting
the indexed reviewer's transactions came from a scripted account
missing: indexed history for a receipt from the production application

bounties.name: Best Builds with Qwen 3.8 Max
bounties.observed: A genuine qwen3.8-max run (provider region ap-southeast-1, JSON-schema output, native tool calls) completed on the synthetic fixture with the four read-only tools read_sources, check_payments, check_evidence and get_status; the returned model equals the requested model and six provider request IDs are recorded. Capability checks for tool calls, structured output, usage reporting and cancellation passed. On 2026-10-13 the hosted app's /api/readiness reported assistant.qwen verified (OK). The operator reports a source-linked analysis was run in the hosted web UI; no recording or evidence file of that run is in the repository yet.
limitations: validation shows references resolve, not that a statement is legally correct
budgets bound attempts and time, not an invoice
per-run token usage is not recorded in the evidence file
missing: recorded evidence of the hosted-UI run

bounties.name: Best Projects using Alchemy
bounties.observed: Through the configured Alchemy Monad endpoint (credential kept server-side, not recorded): chain and genesis reads, canonical-checkpoint code read matching the pinned source, transaction and receipt reads, fee estimation and transaction-count capabilities; on 2026-10-09 an ISSUE, SUPERSEDE and REVOKE were transmitted and monitored to confirmation with measured stage latencies. The hosted app's /api/chain/status returned a live checkpoint (block 70788314, 2026-10-13).
limitations: transactions were signed by a scripted account, not a real Mera device
Alchemy is an RPC provider here, and an RPC read is an observation, not a consensus proof
missing: a confirmed transaction from the deployed application signed through Mera
